evidence.quote: Submit your application and all required documents via our online application portal.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 8,200 EUR per semester for applicants from all countries (i.e. including Morocco); the programme's own page currently states 8,600 EUR/semester. The value given (1,640,000 minor units = 8,200 EUR) follows the DAAD page; the university page figure is quoted as well. Application channel: the programme page says the application goes through the university's own online application portal ("via our online application portal"), and no page mentions uni-assist or a VPD for this programme, so de-university-direct was chosen. Deadlines: the programme's own page gives 30 June 2027 as application deadline and 1 September 2027 as start date for the 2027 intake; a separate FAQ sentence mentions "The application portal is open from 1 September 2025 to 30 June 2026" (an earlier cycle). English B2: the DAAD page states "B2 required, proof via placement test/interview", i.e. proven through the Assessment Centre rather than a certificate. Documents: the pages name the documents for the application; translation requirements are not mentioned on these pages.

evidence.quote: B2 required, proof via placement test/interview
you are not required to submit an English certificate with your application

note.fr: Le diplôme d'études secondaires reconnu est exigé ; vérifier l'équivalence de ton Baccalauréat marocain (DAAD/Anabin).
note.en: A recognised school-leaving certificate is required; check the equivalence of your Moroccan Baccalauréat (DAAD/Anabin).

evidence.quote: Recognised school-leaving certificate (e.g. German Abitur, Fachabitur, IB Diploma, US High School Diploma, A-Levels, European Baccalaureate or equivalent).

note.fr: Réussir l'Online Assessment Centre : test de mathématiques, test cognitif, test d'anglais et entretien.
note.en: Successful completion of the Online Assessment Centre: mathematics test, cognitive test, English test and interview.

evidence.quote: The Assessment Centre, which includes a mathematics test, a cognitive test, an English test and an interview.
